title: Veil and Ember
premise: When the border wards of Thornfell collapse and the stars vanish overhead, memory-thief Cyrus Amberdale discovers the country itself is dissolving — its borders, its history, its people's pasts — because the last dragon, whose fire sustains the realm, is dying. Hunted by the Ember Court, which wants the dragon dead to seize absolute power, Cyrus must carry the stolen memories of the realm's founding to the dragon's mountain heart and rekindle the flame, a task that demands she surrender her own most treasured memories as fuel. She falls in love with Serah, the Court's warder sent to stop her, and in the end Cyrus burns her memories of Serah to light the fire — saving a country that no longer remembers her, while Serah alone carries the memory of what was sacrificed.
about_author: Vesper Vane is the pen name of a former cartographer who once mapped mountain passes across three fictional countries before turning to fiction. She writes fantasy about borders, both the kind drawn on maps and the kind drawn around the heart.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Cyrus Amberdale lifts a memory from a smuggler's mind in the Thornfell lowlands when the border wards shatter and every star vanishes at once. In the sudden dark, she finds a memory vial in her own pack that isn't hers — holding the face of the last dragon. POV: Cyrus. Beat: dread and curiosity igniting.

chapters.title: What Thieves Keep
chapters.summary: Cyrus traces the foreign vial to its dead owner, a Court archivist who died clutching it, and learns the realm's founding memories were scattered the night the wards fell. The Ember Court posts a bounty on 'the thief who holds the fire.' POV: Cyrus. Beat: reluctant responsibility taking root.

chapters.title: The Warder on the Pass
chapters.summary: Ambushed on a smuggler's road, Cyrus is captured by Serah Vey, the Court's warder, who is supposed to arrest her but instead bargains: help her find why the wards failed, and Cyrus walks free. Their uneasy alliance forms over a shared campfire in a country going dark. POV: alternating. Beat: wary attraction.

chapters.title: A Country Unremembering
chapters.summary: In the town of Hollowmere, villagers have forgotten their own names; roads lead in circles; a bridge exists only where someone remembers it. Cyrus realizes the realm isn't under attack — it's being erased, and the scattered memories are its anchor-points. POV: Serah. Beat: horror and dawning complicity, as Serah recognizes the Court's seal on the erasure.

chapters.title: The Ember Court
chapters.summary: Serah is recalled and Cyrus follows her into the Court's citadel, where Lord Chancellor Ashgrave reveals the truth: the Court is feeding the last dragon's fire into their own power, letting the realm dissolve so they can rule what remains. Serah must choose her oath or the truth. POV: Serah. Beat: betrayal, and love declared in a corridor.

chapters.title: Smuggler's Road, Reversed
chapters.summary: Fugitives together, Cyrus and Serah flee through Thornfell using Cyrus's knowledge of roads that only exist because she remembers them — memory literally paving the way. They recover two founding memories from a drowned chapel and a bandit king's grave. POV: Cyrus. Beat: intimacy deepening amid pursuit; the cost of the quest becomes clear — memories are the fuel.

chapters.title: The Guttering Heart
chapters.summary: They reach the dragon's mountain and find Vaelith, the last dragon, barely alive, her fire down to embers. Vaelith shows Cyrus the truth of the founding: the realm was forged from a thief's sacrifice long ago — and only a willing memory, freely given, can renew it. POV: Cyrus. Beat: awe and grief; Cyrus realizes what she must lose.

chapters.title: What the Fire Demands
chapters.summary: Ashgrave's hunters breach the mountain; Serah holds the pass alone while Cyrus carries the founding memories to the heart. Vaelith rises for one last flight. Serah, wounded, chooses the realm over her oath and cuts the Court's siphon. POV: alternating. Beat: sacrifice in motion, love against duty at its sharpest.

chapters.title: Ember
chapters.summary: At the dragon's heart, Cyrus feeds the founding memories into the flame — and then her own memories of Serah: every campfire, every kiss, every road walked together. The fire roars back; the stars return; the borders reknit. Cyrus lives, whole and hollow, not knowing why she weeps. POV: Cyrus. Beat: climax and devastation.

chapters.title: Veil
chapters.summary: The realm remembers itself again, and no record of Cyrus's deed remains — except in Serah, who kept a copy of every stolen moment in a single vial she refuses to burn. She finds Cyrus on a smuggler's road and offers her the memories back, one by one, to be relearned together. POV: Serah. Beat: bittersweet resolution — love outlasting its own erasure.
